text:
maria: spotted odd KMS grant activity from partner-integ svc account, looks like a cross-project binding created yesterday evening. audit log shows iam.bind on kmsKeyRing key1 by partner-bot@partner (suspicious).
oliver: yikes. did the partner onboarding run recently? any new terraform apply? :eyes:
ash: partner infra claims they only ran a config sync. I'm pulling the audit JSON now.
maria: pasted the log snippet:
```
{"protoPayload": {"methodName": "google.iam.v1.IAM.BindRole", "principalEmail": "partner-bot@partner", "resourceName": "projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/key1", "request": {"role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"}
```
ash: that binding would allow wrap/unwrap on that key, so any wrapped blobs could be decrypted by partner svc. need to check blast radius.
rotor-bot: [automated] flagged grant as unusual based on entity reputation and time-of-day. suggested actions: revoke grant, snapshot key usage, notify oncall.
sam: recommend immediate containment: revoke binding, rotate affected envelope keys, and rotate any service tokens that used KMS for secrets. can we list keys encrypted with key1?
oliver: run this to list CMEK usage in GCP (rough):
```
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/prod --query="cryptoKeys/name:key1" --format=json
```
maria: also check Vault transit wrappers: some teams use key1 to wrap blobs before putting into Vault. I’m scanning vault audit log for unwrap using key1-wrapped tokens.
devops-oncall: if we revoke binding, some jobs might fail. propose a staged revoke + rotation: 1) create temp grant for SRE to scrub, 2) revoke partner grant, 3) rotate key or rewrap backups, 4) rotate service tokens.
ash: agree. quick plan: - create emergency service account with restricted role - grant to that SA so we can rewrap - revoke partner binding - run rewrap script - rotate tokens
sam: estimated time: partner grant revoke + rewrap for affected buckets ~30-90m depending on rewrap throughput. token rotation depends on number of services (I'll enumerate).
maria: action items: @ash to pull complete audit export and identify all principals that used key1 in last 30d. @oliver to run asset search and list dependant resources. @sam to prepare token rotation playbook and list impacted apps. @devops-oncall to stand by for staged revoke window (T+10m after approvals).
ash: uploading audit export link: https://logs.company.internal/export/43721-key1-audit.json :lock:
oliver: asset search results show 3 buckets, 2 cloud functions, and one vault transit key alias referencing key1.
sam: I'll start building rotation PR for creds and a canary script to rotate one app and smoke test. prefer to do in low-traffic window.
maria: we should also update alerting: add a rule to flag cross-project KMS bindings and increase retention for KMS audit logs for 90d.
rotor-bot: [automated] created incident INC-2026-031: kms-crossproject-grant-detected. paging oncall.
devops-oncall: acknowledged. prepping maintenance window in 15m for canary revoke. will coordinate with infra-team.
oliver: one more thing — check IAM conditions. partner grant might be conditional; if so we can narrow scope instead of full revoke.
maria: confirmed conditionless grant. proceeding with staged revoke. I'll post updates here.
ash: revoke complete. partner binding removed at 4372110001. monitoring for failures.
maria: rewrap started. running rewrap script:
```
python tools/rewrap_kms.py --key old=key1 --key new=key1-rotated --projects prod --parallel 8
```
sam: canary app rotated and smoke passed. no auth errors observed.
devops-oncall: rewrap complete for listed resources at 4372110280. starting token rotation jobs now.
maria: token rotation PR merged and started rolling by canary groups. will keep this thread for postmortem notes and runbook updates.
oliver: please add a short blameless postmortem and include the terraform runbook and vendor onboarding checklist updates.
maria: noted. closing incident once all rotations finish and audit retention rule is in place. thanks all :thumbsup:
